name: A_original
caption: Peaceful Indian devotional Sanskrit mantra chant, Hindu temple bhajan, slow and melodious, every syllable pronounced clearly in classical Sanskrit, long resonant Om. Warm rich deep Indian male vocal. Tanpura drone, bansuri flute, harmonium, soft tabla, temple bells. Calm, spiritual.
lyrics:
[Verse]
ॐ मित्राय नमः। ॐ रवये नमः।
ॐ सूर्याय नमः। ॐ भानवे नमः।
ॐ हिरण्यगर्भाय नमः। ॐ भास्कराय नमः।

[Chorus]
ॐ आदित्याय विद्महे मार्तण्डाय धीमहि।
तन्नः सूर्यः प्रचोदयात्॥
